curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk the backing routine: look behind before getting in, set hands and body to look back, use the camera only with mirrors and a shoulder look, and back slowly.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per step; contrast card for the camera versus looking back.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover who directs traffic, how signal lights are arranged, and what to do when a signal is dark.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each control and the dark-signal rule; contrast card for four-way stop versus busier road.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on following officers and broken signals.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the steady red rule and turns on red, then steady yellow and steady green with its yield duty.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per light; contrast card for right on red versus left on red.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what a driver may do at each steady light.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach red, green, steady yellow and flashing yellow arrows, including when a green arrow goes dark.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per arrow; contrast card for a dark green arrow with a round green.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on turning at arrow signals.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover flashing red and flashing yellow lights, compare them with steady and arrow signals, and explain the HAWK pedestrian signal.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each flashing signal; contrast cards for steady versus flashing red and light versus arrow.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what signs tell you, regulatory sign colors, speed limits, stop sign stopping points and yield signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each sign rule; contrast card for the stop-point order.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on regulatory sign duties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach wrong-way signs, one-way signs, lane control signs and prohibited-action signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each sign; contrast card for one-way versus wrong-way.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on which way a driver may go.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover warning and advisory speed signs, railroad crossing safety and emergency notification signs, work zone signs, and guide, service and recreation signs by color.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each sign family; a contrast card for the color code.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz matching sign colors and railroad duties.
